name: CDR Print Readiness Checker
description: Run a guided CorelDRAW print-preflight assessment covering bleed, color mode, fonts, image resolution, transparency, overprint and output preparation.
search_intent: Check common CorelDRAW print-preparation requirements before sending artwork to a printer.
calculation: Deterministic checklist scoring and issue reporting from user-confirmed preflight conditions. Do not claim to inspect proprietary CDR document internals that the browser cannot reliably parse.
